summary: Complete frontend testing of redesigned Brightluxx homepage and navigation. All 11 features tested and verified working correctly. Navigation redesign successful with Technologies/Tools moved to hamburger menu, Get Quote removed from header, all header text UPPERCASE, and logo displaying properly.

issues: Stats label shows 'SQM LED INSTALLED' instead of 'LED AREA' - minor text difference, functionality correct

features_tested.feature: Navigation header displays correctly with PRODUCTS, SOLUTIONS dropdowns and 5 product families in UPPERCASE
features_tested.details: All navigation items found with correct data-testid: nav-products (PRODUCTS), nav-solutions (SOLUTIONS), nav-lumimorph (LUMIMORPH), nav-naturatex (NATURATEX), nav-signatouch (SIGNATOUCH), nav-glassmorph (GLASSMORPH), nav-pixelvue (PIXELVUE). All text is UPPERCASE.

features_tested.feature: Get Quote button is NOT present in the header
features_tested.details: Verified that no 'Get Quote' button exists in the header navigation. It has been successfully removed as per requirements.

features_tested.feature: Hamburger/More menu (≡ icon) contains Technologies, Tools, and Company links
features_tested.details: nav-more-btn found. More dropdown contains: TECHNOLOGIES section (COB Technology, GOB Protection, MicroLED & MiP, HDR & Color, Driving ICs), SPECIFIER TOOLS section (Screen Calculator, Budget Estimator, Viewing Distance, Power Estimator, Technology Selector), and COMPANY section (About Us, Blog, Contact Us, FAQ, Resources, Case Studies, Factory Tour, Distribution).

features_tested.feature: Logo 'BRIGHTLUXX' displays properly without being cut off
features_tested.details: Logo image dimensions: 160px x 32px. Logo is visible and not cut off. Uses image-based logo at /assets/brightluxx-logo-nav.png with proper sizing.

features_tested.feature: Hero section shows 'ENGINEERING BRILLIANCE' in large uppercase text with GET QUOTE and EXPLORE CTAs
features_tested.details: Hero section found with data-testid='hero-section'. Title shows 'ENGINEERING BRILLIANCE' in large uppercase. GET QUOTE CTA (data-testid='home-hero-primary-cta') and EXPLORE CTA (data-testid='home-hero-secondary-cta') both present.

features_tested.feature: Stats section displays 4 stats with gradient numbers
features_tested.details: Stats section found with data-testid='project-stats-section'. Displays 4 stats: 1,376+ Screens Installed, 516+ Satisfied Clients, 688+ Projects Completed, 10,320 SQM LED Installed. Numbers have gradient styling.

features_tested.feature: Product Families section shows all 5 families with tall image cards and UPPERCASE text
features_tested.details: Product Families section found with data-testid='product-families-section'. All 5 families displayed: LUMIMORPH (Textured LED Panels), NATURATEX (Natural Texture Screens), SIGNATOUCH (Interactive Kiosks), GLASSMORPH (Smart Glass Solutions), PIXELVUE (Professional LED Displays). Each has tall image card with proper styling.

features_tested.feature: Projects section displays featured projects with full-bleed images
features_tested.details: Featured Projects section found with data-testid='featured-projects-section'. Displays 6 featured project cards with full-bleed images and gradient overlays.

features_tested.feature: Why Brightluxx section shows 4 minimal feature cards with icons
features_tested.details: Why Brightluxx section found with data-testid='why-brightluxx-section'. Shows 4 feature cards: Direct Factory, Gulf-Grade Stock, Fast Delivery, CPD Training. Each with icon and description.

features_tested.feature: Products section displays featured products in clean grid
features_tested.details: Featured Products section found with data-testid='featured-products-section'. Displays 4 featured product cards in a clean grid layout with images, product codes, and names.

features_tested.feature: CTA section has START YOUR PROJECT and SCREEN CALCULATOR buttons
features_tested.details: CTA section found with data-testid='cta-section'. Shows 'LET'S BUILD SOMETHING BRILLIANT' headline. START YOUR PROJECT button (data-testid='home-cta-contact') and SCREEN CALCULATOR button (data-testid='home-cta-calculator') both present and working.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage and navigation redesign complete with: 1) Header redesigned - PRODUCTS/SOLUTIONS dropdowns, 5 product families (LUMIMORPH, NATURATEX, SIGNATOUCH, GLASSMORPH, PIXELVUE) all UPPERCASE, hamburger menu (≡) for Technologies/Tools/Company, no Get Quote button in header. 2) Logo uses image at /assets/brightluxx-logo-nav.png at 160x32px. 3) Hero section has 'ENGINEERING BRILLIANCE' headline with GET QUOTE and EXPLORE CTAs. 4) All homepage sections working: Stats (4 items), Product Families (5 cards), Featured Projects, Why Brightluxx (4 cards), Featured Products, CTA section.
